description: Deterministic cross-runtime byte-equality artifact for the Distractor Derivation Model (Property 27, task 14.24). Inputs are a stable, counter-driven enumeration of the shared task-13.1 generated-input domain; each incoming_numeric_token is preserved verbatim and every expected outcome is produced by the Go reference derive() and serialized with the canonical encoder. Rows are enumerated by a single stable counter (the `index` is the replay_identity), so regeneration is byte-identical. Replayed byte-for-byte by the Go reference (agent-go/derivation_property27_cross_runtime_test.go), the Worker port (tests/node/derivation_property27_cross_runtime.test.ts), and the Functions port (functions/tests/derivation_property27_cross_runtime.test.ts) to prove identical inputs produce identical serialized bytes across all three runtimes. The optional `metadata` field is an ignorable paired pack/round difficulty wrapper that never crosses the DDM interface. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with GEN_DERIVATION_CROSS_RUNTIME=1 go test ./agent-go -run TestGenerateDerivationCrossRuntime.
